sources.observation: The original waterfront facade has a projecting central clock, six principal rows of glazing, a heavy sandstone cornice and narrow roof terraces behind it.

sources.credit: Pieter Naessens / Museum of Contemporary Art Australia
sources.observation: The Mordant Wing has offset light and umber volumes resting over a glass entry. Its broad stairs meet the waterside plaza.

limitations: The masonry courses, gallery heights, plaza datum and the setbacks of the modern volumes are estimated from exterior photographs and the available maps.
